title: modmod
description: DiamondFire QOL mod for support staff and moderators
body:
## modmod DiamondFire mod with various QOL features for support staff and moderators, so you can burn out and quit DF faster. > **General Features** - Custom node select screen (keybind `K`) - Hypercube item tag viewer (`CTRL` in dev mode) - Item lore HUD display - Custom CPU bar display > **Staff Features** - Track players and draws their outline on screen (`/track `) - Shows active support sessions and recent question on screen - Custom moderator screen with common ban / mute reasons (keybind `X`) - Punishment durations are automatically determined based on /history - Only works on tracked players - Custom report screen (keybind `O`) - Click on reports to automatically vanish and go to the node its from - Instant mod vanish acceleration - Auto /support queue on join - More readable session spy message (for SrHelper) > **Aliases** - `/mv` (`/mod vanish`) (Mod) - `/tcmv` (clears tracker list and toggles vanish) (Mod) - `/queue` (`/support queue`) (Helper) - `/cs ` (`/support spectate-code `) (SrHelper) `/modmod` - opens config
Features you don't have permission to use will be disabled automatically.
If your permissions change while use the mod, corresponding features will be enabled / disabled accordingly. [More info on how to use this mod (mostly for staff)](https://github.com/miawara/modmod/wiki) Idea for hit range indicators is from https://github.com/uku3lig/hitrange
